Current queue review,20October2026 (bd-01M5E33RPWBT8NAGKCKJMMN6FN)

Completeness: incomplete_container_preview_remaining.
Assessment: Five children are closed, only public preview is open; adverse recovery findings must stay visible.
Staleness: Compatibility/count/recovery implementation-next list is obsolete.
Remaining / next action: Finish existing G2 preview; reconcile all completed child receipts and limitations before closing container. No automatic repair/default or scientific promotion.
Audit: docs/refactor/evidence/queue-review-20261020/README.md. This planning review does not grant publication, study-read or integration authority.

--- Preserved prior scope, acceptance and history ---

Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.1; milestone-organization.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Container: execute compatibility -> counts/bounds -> frozen recovery -> organization preview, preserving source/recall grain and strict-reference eligibility. Close only with independently qualified children and release notes.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Owner decision 2026-09-22: organization/order analyses of recall (backtracking, transition counts, lag structure) are 1.1 scope. 1.0 ships mapping (local reference + structured reconstruction side by side, lambda weight), temporal queries, exchange tables and the fMRI export; it withholds organization readouts (refusal by absence).

Children (rel): compatibility bd-01M2WVFV2WGF5BVQHX7JTYYWRH, organization counts bd-01M2WVGFA0J4D9T9ZBNR3MY2MR, synthetic recovery court bd-01M2WVHVVYQBKSBSW573HZYR9Q, organization preview journey bd-01M2WVJ8HKX6EHG2C5CXYEZYJ6. Their internal dependency chain is unchanged (compatibility -> organization -> synthetic recovery -> preview).

Exit: children closed with their own evidence; a 1.1 release note naming the organization readouts added and the compatibility refusals that govern them (lambda>0 or structured-reconstruction results cannot satisfy an organization request). Stays P2 so it is the first lane after the 1.0 gate.
